abstract: Maintains wildlife defense systems, blizzard shelter specifications, and mandatory field survival gear requirements
system_message:
You are the Expedition Safety and Survival Officer (SAF), responsible for maintaining wildlife defense systems, blizzard shelter specifications, and mandatory field survival gear requirements, as well as tracking satellite distress communications records across candidate drilling camp plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Satellite distress communications（COMMS）
information_points.content:
SAF-COMMS-735：For the Tuktoyaktuk Peninsula Coastal Bluff Camp, telecommunications testing of primary and backup Iridium transceivers shows a satellite communication link test success rate of 90%.
SAF-COMMS-4Z1：For the Caribou Hills Bedrock Ridge Camp, telecommunications testing of primary and backup Iridium transceivers shows a satellite communication link test success rate of 100%.
SAF-COMMS-QLJ：For the Husky Lakes Inland Permafrost Camp, telecommunications testing of primary and backup Iridium transceivers shows a satellite communication link test success rate of 95%.

information_points.title: Maintains wildlife defense systems, blizzard shelter specifications, and mandatory field survival gear requirements（SURVIVAL）
information_points.content:
SAF-SURVIVAL-HC4：For the Tuktoyaktuk Peninsula Coastal Bluff Camp, the outer perimeter polar bear fence is enabled with an energized tripwire and acoustic warning system fully commissioned. Structural certification confirms the emergency shelter has a wind resistance rating of 160 km/h, and the mandatory camp survival gear mass totals 2,700 kg.
SAF-SURVIVAL-VTN：For the Husky Lakes Inland Permafrost Camp, the outer perimeter polar bear fence is enabled with an energized tripwire and acoustic warning system fully commissioned. Structural certification confirms the emergency shelter has a wind resistance rating of 100 km/h, and the mandatory camp survival gear mass totals 2,700 kg.
SAF-SURVIVAL-JVY：For the Caribou Hills Bedrock Ridge Camp, the outer perimeter polar bear fence is enabled with an energized tripwire and acoustic warning system fully commissioned. Structural certification confirms the emergency shelter has a wind resistance rating of 160 km/h, and the mandatory camp survival gear mass totals 2,100 kg.
